# KP500 Flashing Tool

**Author:** Infineon Technologies Denmark A/S<br/>
**Platforms:** APOXI

<div className="screenshot">

![KP500 Flashing Tool: screenshot 1](./kp500-flashing-tool/img/kp500-flashing-tool.png)

</div>

A variant of FlashTool E2 for the LG KP500. The program writes firmware files via the Infineon serial or USB interface.

The package includes the IFWD Download DLL, FlashUSB driver, Prolific PL-2303 cable driver, and USB driver installation instructions.
